gen-gf-phudu-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Phudu's curves open generously at every terminal, drawn with the pressure-free ease of a ballpoint line, and M PLUS Code Latin follows as a plain sans. Loud meets tidy here.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Phudu hits hard, its diagonals every bit as heavy as its verticals, while M PLUS Rounded 1c sits beside it with terminals that stop short of curling. And the sans-serif keeps things approachable.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-mandali: Mandali gives its e a generous entry and a friendly sans feel, with no hairlines or swells anywhere in Phudu's letters to compete. And that shared smoothness is the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-manjari: Manjari is a sans-serif whose curves end in wide, unclosed terminals and keep one steady line weight, a quiet foil for Phudu's display bravado. Its strength is restraint.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-meera-inimai: Phudu opens every curve with generous terminals and a bold, ballpoint-plain line, while Meera Inimai adds a sans with blueprint-like constancy. Their strongest quality is shared openness.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-metrophobic: Modern and clean, Metrophobic moves smoothly around each bend. Phudu's strokes look like drawn wire throughout, so set the plain sans body a touch larger and let it hold its own.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-mina: Mina draws its sans strokes as plainly as stitched thread, leaving each small round letter generously unclosed. Phudu does the loud, distinctive work up top; Mina simply gets on with the reading.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-mingzat: Mingzat's curvy letters feel unclamped, loose as a plain sans can be. Phudu has no thick and thin parts in any letter, so the two share a smooth, bold-to-relaxed rhythm on the page.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-moderustic: Moderustic reads like curves traced with a broad nib and left deliberately unfinished, a contemporary sans with some looseness. Phudu's ribbon of constant width feels brash beside it, yet they sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-momo-trust-sans: Chunky, friendly, a little cheeky: Phudu's open curves lead while Momo Trust Sans backs them up with bowls as heavy as its stems. And that sans-serif keeps wide, unclosed mouths, so paragraphs stay inviting.
